repairs.quote: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing (80/95/110 + (50% Ability Power) + (2% Mana)) magic damage. Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next 15 seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional (35/45/55 + (7% Ability Power) + (1% Mana)) magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to 4 times.
